notes.title: The Restart
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Yello![/b] My name is Filip, and I am the developer of Too Much Water

I have seen many different versions of Too Much Water. Likewise, Too Much Water has seen many different versions of me. It really shows how much I've grown as both a person and a game developer. I have made many attempts to make Too Much Water feel how I want it to. It was on this current attempt that I wrongly convinced myself that this would be the one.

[i]"I didn't want to lose the progress that I had already made. I felt like I was on a roll. I could not be stopped."[/i]

Fast forward to today, and I am constantly suffering from and- worse- fighting burnout, digging me deeper into that hole. Fitting new content in with code I wrote when I was fifteen is stressful and unpredictable. When something goes wrong, I feel helpless.

I want to make this game a better experience for everyone, but I need time to do that. One mistake I made while working on this project was I was constantly working against the clock. My life was full of stress to the point where I lost sleep over some of the most insignificant issues. I had to get one more line of code in before I could rest just a little bit easier.

Don't get me wrong- I loved programming. I still do! I could do it for days on end and never get tired. It was my go-to activity when I was stressed or bored.

As the scope of the game got larger and less clear, I found myself stepping away from working on the project for longer and longer periods of time just to give myself a break. A break from what I loved to do.

[i]In a way, working on Too Much Water was my zen, but it was also my Hell.[/i]

[b]Despite all this, I remain optimistic.[/b]

I am not giving up on Too Much Water. I am simply restarting the project with a clean canvas. A canvas that will be painted, polished, framed, and hung up for everyone to observe in the world's largest museum- the Internet.

If you'd like to be a part of this journey or even if you're remotely curious, I ask you to check out the game and join the [url=https://discord.gg/2zch5Dv]Discord server[/url]. Let me know what you think of the project. I'll be taking all feedback, every single point, and improving the new game based on those criticisms.

Thank you for reading.

Join the Discord Server: https://discord.gg/2zch5Dv

notes.title: Flash Theater Update
notes.notes:
[Below is an excerpt from my [url=https://filiprb.newgrounds.com/news/post/1279651]Newgrounds post[/url]]

This update was created to honor the life and death of Adobe Flash, and features the voice of Stamper as he guides you through the Flash Theater. This huge side-quest in Too Much Water has been in the works for a year and a half and was actually supposed to be released last Pico Day. notes.title: Too Much Water - SUMMER UPDATE
notes.notes:
[b]TIME TO PUT ON SUNSCREEN![/b]
As if it wasn't hot enough already... Summer is here! And- the sun has never shined brighter.


[b]SUMMER UPDATE![/b]
With the addition of some quality-of-life features, there are also a couple new fun things to find, discover, craft, and encounter! I'm not here to spoil anything, though... Look around for yourself!

I decided to release this Summer update as I had promised earlier this year. I felt like it would be unfair to make you wait longer for the patch that fixes the game's unplayable state. (In other words, it's playable now.)

One thing that has been suggested many times by the community is the implementation of a 16:9 aspect ratio. I can proudly state that this update has replaced the old 4:3 aspect ratio with a new widescreen 16:9 aspect ratio. NO MORE BLACK BARS!!

[b]QUICK LIST OF CHANGES:[/b]
- Revamped UI
- New Random Dialogue Encounter
- Island Encounters
- Fixed Lag Issues on Windows 10
- MORE

notes.title: Too Much Water - MacOSX Announcement
notes.notes:
For over three years, Too Much Water has only been available to play on systems running Windows. Today I am releasing a build of the game that should run on any up-to-date Mac computer! I'm hoping that I can extend my player-base by giving Apple enthusiasts the opportunity to play Too Much Water on their favourite devices! There are some bugs, but the game is still in a surprisingly playable state.

A couple things I would like to mention: The second ending currently does not work properly on Mac builds. The reason for this is unknown, but I will continue to research this for the future. The Mac version of Too Much Water will be updated a lot less frequently due to how much of a hassle it is to actually get the old stuff working with the new stuff, and vise-versa with every new build. Think of this as Mac users getting a more refined treatment, while people on Windows platforms are getting the newer and buggier features first. It's not a BAD thing, but it can be looked at that way.

I'm considering looking towards a Linux build of Too Much Water. While this is possible in theory, I'd probably wait on adding support until the game is in an outstandingly playable state with all endings working, or if Linux is highly requested by the community.

Speaking of the community, you can join the Discord server here: https://discord.gg/2zch5Dv

notes.title: Christmas Event!
notes.notes:
[b]Merry Christmas and Happy Holidays to everyone![/b]

To celebrate the holiday season, I've added a new sort of sidequest; you can now find presents and collect them like regular items. At the moment, Christmas items will only be for the "funnies," but I plan to have some Easter (Easter?) eggs correlating to the gifts you can find, and a menu for those gifts. You will only be able to find these gifts on the 25th of December, so play while you can!

Thank you [url=https://www.castingcall.club/m/Ross%20K]Ross K[/url] for being the voice of Santa!

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Thinking forward, I think every year I'll give a celebrity, an influencer, or media personality their own customized dialogue. It'll be a tradition I do every year. Who will be the influencer for the year 2021? We'll have to wait and see ;)

I'll make a new years post with more information on the yearly event. In the same post I'll be revealing who the influencer is.

I've got big plans for Too Much Water, so stick with me!

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b]EDIT - Friday, December 25th, 2:13AM[/b]
I just spent two and a half hours working on a holiday inventory category/rarity. Now you can actually see how many items you've got, along with the items (obviously). If I have time once I wake up today, I'll add in a couple of the Easter Eggs, as well as give you all an actual reason to participate in the Christmas event. (A reward of some sort? Possibly 1000 Zennas for collecting every item?) Whatever I decide to put as an incentive, I'll try my best to find some time tomorrow. Goodnight!

notes.title: Too Much Water - Early Access Release
notes.notes:
A year after being released to GameJolt, Too Much Water gets a Steam release. I'm really excited for people to finally get the chance to play the game. A couple things need fixing, but I'm working hard on getting everything fixed and put into a stable state.

If anyone decides to stream the game or wants to make a video, let me know! I'd love to watch everything my community puts out.

The credits aren't finished in the game, and I'm planning on removing the button from the title screen soon when I get the final credits implemented. I would like to thank Evan Sarkozi for helping me with the game. Too Much Water wouldn't exist without his support, and his amazing ideas.

There are too many people to thank individually for this release post, but I'm working on crediting everyone for the end of the game.

Is the game finished? I've got so much more that I want to add, so no. Not in the slightest. There's still so much I want to add, so much to fix, so much to finish. I want to hope I'll have the game finished by the beginning of Summer 2021, but then again, I wanted to get farther than the game is now before Summer 2020 ended, and well... Yeah...

Does this mean that the game won't be updated? Of course Too Much Water will be updated! The early access release means I'll be updating the game regularly as I go. I'm not finished with the game the way it is. You can probably beat the game in less than an hour with a lot of practice and patience, after all, and some endings aren't finished.

With all that being said, Too Much Water IS ready for people to play the game! I'll be active around the community gathering feedback, taking suggestions, etc. Post away!

Oh and if you want to join the Discord Server: https://discord.gg/2zch5Dv
